check.title: Returned GKE workload literals have no detected secrets
check.remediation: Remove credential literals from ConfigMaps and Pod environment values, commands and arguments, and rotate confirmed exposed credentials. Prefer workload identity and authorized runtime secret retrieval, or managed secret references, instead of embedding credentials.
evidence_sentences: A likely secret was detected in the returned GKE workload configuration.
The value is hidden; offline detection did not validate the credential.

shared_source_note: Coordinator-owned shared sources can move without a freeze. Full focused suite source baseline and regenerated native fixture baseline are recorded separately; root integration/admission must validate its final shared baseline.

primary_docs.title: gke_cluster
primary_docs.supports: Native short name, location, selfLink, IP endpoint and base64 public root CA are separate authority facts; no synthetic full Cluster.name.

primary_docs.title: gke_list
primary_docs.supports: Existing native unpaged list under projects/locations/- returns clusters and missingZones; missing zones are incomplete.

primary_docs.title: gke_auth
primary_docs.supports: Google user/service account OAuth authentication requires email scope and authorization; existing token scope metadata may be unavailable, so pinned native reads enforce auth/RBAC.

primary_docs.title: gke_access
primary_docs.supports: GKE Kubernetes authorization is distinct from cluster metadata access; IAM or RBAC must authorize the actual resource read.

primary_docs.title: configmap
primary_docs.supports: ConfigMap data is textual; binaryData can be non-UTF8 and cannot overlap data keys. This candidate supports only strict UTF8 decoded binaryData.

primary_docs.title: pod
primary_docs.supports: Pod container/init/ephemeral specs expose literal env, args, command and valueFrom/envFrom references; references are not resolved.

primary_docs.title: namespace
primary_docs.supports: Read-only native namespace list provides bounded namespace discovery when selection is not explicit.

primary_docs.title: pagination
primary_docs.supports: limit/continue list pagination must complete, with consistent list resourceVersion; exhausted pages, repeated cursors, changed version or malformed native shapes are not complete.

actual_producer.native_gcp: Existing gke_cluster scope job GET container.googleapis.com/v1/projects/{project}/locations/-/clusters, pages key clusters, no page-size/fields mask.
actual_producer.binding: Complete collected cluster envelope + successful exact native list request receipts + short name/location/project selfLink equality + selected canonical resource scope + public IPv4 + currently valid self-signed CA -> TLS context trusting only that native CA.
actual_producer.discovered_gap: Generic envelope coalesces duplicate native selfLinks; optional bridge source validator must reject duplicate/conflicting raw cluster subjects before coalescing. Exact root hook proposed and native response proof added.

required: exact selected_gke_clusters plus original explicit project scopes
exact optional per-cluster namespace mapping or complete bounded native namespace discovery
authorization.credentials: Existing pasted token, valid Google SDK token or already-cached unexpired gcloud token; no refresh, filesystem kubeconfig, credential helpers or token inspection endpoint in bridge.
authorization.scope_status: Absent scope metadata is not an inferred missing scope. Google documents userinfo.email; native pinned 401/403 is UNKNOWN and successful lists support only the returned read, never general permissions.
authorization.conditional_scope_proposal: Root-owned refreshable Credentials request cloud-platform+userinfo.email only when auth_requested verifies the named explicit GKE plan. Normal credential scopes remain unchanged; no shared change applied.

kubernetes_transport.tls: stdlib HTTPSConnection native public IPv4:443, CERT_REQUIRED + hostname check + TLS>=1.2 + SSLContext containing only parsed native CA; no proxies or endpoint/CA/token overrides.
kubernetes_transport.stream: Identity encoding only; bounded Content-Length equality or successful native chunk framing; real in-memory http.client test rejects valid JSON without terminating chunk.
kubernetes_transport.cache: No Kubernetes body, headers, cookies, snippets or raw errors enter generic transport cache or snapshot. Raw objects are immediately projected before return; source Google cluster metadata cache remains existing behavior.
kubernetes_transport.sharing: Global native transport call counter, cancel checks and deadlines apply; additional per-project bridge read/scan/resource/time budgets bound the whole selection.

ConfigMap: binaryData canonical base64 -> strict UTF8 string map
literal_surfaces.references: secretKeyRef/configMapKeyRef/envFrom refs and bounded downward references retained as references only, without reading values. Token volumes and other Pod spec/status content are discarded.
literal_surfaces.omissions: Omitted ConfigMap maps and literal arrays mean empty only on bound full native v1 objects. Missing Pod containers, invalid unions/maps/binary content or PartialObjectMetadata never prove absence.

consumer: Requires authorized selection metadata, complete scoped workload and native cluster envelopes, exact CA/IP and namespace bindings, successful source request receipts for all selected lists, native object name/UID/resourceVersion, complete supported surface coverage and both pinned engines. Contradictions, partial/denied/unproven states are UNKNOWN.

verdicts.FAIL: A supported likely secret in a completely assessed returned supported workload object; value hidden and not verified.
verdicts.PASS: Both offline tools found no supported match in that returned supported literal configuration only; other workloads, runtime expansions, images and managed secret values are outside the claim.
verdicts.UNKNOWN: Disabled/unbound selection, denied/private/unreachable or untrusted endpoint/CA, missing/expired existing credentials, partial discovery/list, malformed/ambiguous subjects, bounds/deadline/cancellation or either tool failure. Empty inventories do not invent a passing resource.

actual_tools.proof: Synthetic native ConfigMap text/binary and Pod literal positives and negatives through actual source/collector pipeline; shared same-value HMAC fingerprint deduplicates engines, surfaces, namespaces and clusters into one finding.
actual_tools.privacy: Shared transient _redact_values callback + redact_matches removes detected literals recurring in reference metadata, marking changed fields UNKNOWN. Assertions exclude payload token/base64, caller bearer and arbitrary workload metadata from envelopes, findings, source receipts, generic cache, redacted scanner cache and captured output.

runtime_cases.pipeline: Native GCP source -> installed source ambiguity hook -> verified pinned native Kubernetes mock -> transient shared scan -> real GCP envelope -> sealed snapshot/resources -> engine._index/MemoIndex -> pure callback
runtime_cases.fixtures: Synthetic public CA only, no private keys/bearer/literals exported; Compressed native Pod PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN CASES installed only through explicit install(); full six native cases retained in runtime export.

known_unproved_branches: Shared hooks, registry, canonical/copy, public selection validation and admission are root-owned; root hook integration was observed while finalizing, and the focused suite was rerun successfully against that state. This worker applied no shared edits and does not certify final root admission.

Conditional refreshable credential scope request was handed off as a compiled proposal and gating-tested; root integration is observed but no live token/RBAC authorization proof is asserted. Existing tokens without scope metadata can attempt only the proven pinned endpoint.
No live TLS handshake, actual cluster reachability, production IAM/RBAC/grants, DNS topology, cloud quotas or throughput certified.

Only public IPv4 IP endpoints and a currently valid self-signed single native public CA are supported; private endpoints, IPv6, DNS-only endpoints, legacy/numeric project aliases, gateway/proxy/client-certificate/Kubernetes-token/kubeconfig methods remain UNKNOWN or unsupported.

No cluster-wide/all-workload/history/runtime/image command/template/volume/Secret-value coverage claim. Only returned ConfigMaps and Pod literal fields in selected or bounded discovered namespaces are inspected.
Strict canonical standard base64/UTF8 only; non-UTF8/URL-safe/unpadded binaryData is UNKNOWN. New relaxed environment variable names outside conservative identifier syntax are unsupported.
Per-list resourceVersion continuity is checked; no atomic cross-kind/cross-namespace/cross-cluster snapshot or current-state freshness guarantee.
Parsed public native CA remains source metadata; source raw client auth fields are already removed by existing sanitizer. No client certificate/key API or key-generation requests are added.

Detected plaintext, JSON escaping and one standard/URL-safe base64 layer are redacted from retained metadata with UNKNOWN field coverage; arbitrary encodings or unmatched sensitive text in identifiers are not universally certified.
SDK lock acquisition, process teardown, TLS/network scheduling and CPU work are cooperative bounded behavior, not a hard real-time guarantee.
Pattern completeness and credential usability are unproved; no leaked credential validation or Secret Manager access occurs.
attribution: Shared peaso.secret_scanning/secret_findings detection, redaction and dedup.
Prior Function/Logging/additional literal test patterns reused with attribution; new GKE native authority, TLS-context, RBAC, namespace/pagination and forbidden-path proofs are directed tests.

integration_followup.redaction: Transient detected-value callback feeds shared redact_matches; changed references carry detected_secret_redacted UNKNOWN coverage and consumer cannot treat them as complete.
integration_followup.harness: Actual GCPCollector.dependent_jobs, installed source hook and actual Credentials; no SUPPORTED_TYPES/DEPENDENCIES/pages source overlays. Python socket connect/connect_ex/create_connection/getaddrinfo forbidden.
integration_followup.registration: Explicit idempotent install() uses normal register and source-produced compressed native Pod PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN CASES; root owns registry import/canonical admission.
integration_followup.independent_regression: Exact acceptance node included in current focused JUnit; old 89-test baseline is historical only.
